minute_attack_variables.contact_high_break: decision close exceeds prior attack high
minute_attack_variables.down_minute_volume_share: causal normalized volume on down minutes / total
minute_attack_variables.inside_gap_ratio_{5,15,30}: share completed trailing attack closes with 0<=z<=1
minute_attack_variables.max_z: max completed attack high z through decision
minute_attack_variables.min_z_after_contact: min completed attack low z through decision
minute_attack_variables.multiday_turnover_without_progress: turnover on completed attack sessions whose max z fails to improve
minute_attack_variables.opening_jump_flag: attack/trigger occurs on first bar and open>=trigger
minute_attack_variables.post_retest_higher_low: post-retest low exceeds previous post-contact low
minute_attack_variables.rejection_depth_z: minimum completed close z below zero
minute_attack_variables.stock_minus_board_intraday_return: stock open-to-clock minus same-clock board return
minute_attack_variables.stock_minus_industry_intraday_return: stock open-to-clock minus same-clock PIT-industry return
minute_attack_variables.time_to_first_rejection: completed minutes from attack start to first close<L
minute_attack_variables.time_to_reclaim: completed minutes from first rejection to later reclaim
minute_attack_variables.turnover_per_unit_progress: causal attack turnover / max z progress
minute_attack_variables.up_minute_volume_share: causal normalized volume on up minutes / total
minute_attack_variables.vwap_hold_ratio: share completed attack closes >= running VWAP
minute_attack_variables.vwap_slope: OLS slope of completed attack running VWAP

state_clock: ATTACK_START_TIME for admission; candidate completed trigger time for minute translation

variables.above_u_lvn_score: one minus above-U density relative to local-bin mean, same descriptive clipping
variables.approach_path_efficiency_10d: absolute prior-10 return divided by sum absolute returns
variables.breadth_recovery: prior-5 market positive breadth minus gap-day positive breadth
variables.cum_turnover_since_cluster_freeze: completed turnover from cluster freeze through attack start
variables.cum_turnover_since_gap: completed turnover from gap formation through attack start
variables.days_since_last_rejection: calendar-index distance from prior rejection end
variables.decayed_overhang_above_u: turnover-decayed float-turnover proxy in 1<=z<2 through attack start
variables.decayed_overhang_inside_gap: turnover-decayed float-turnover proxy inside 0<=z<1 through attack start
variables.decayed_support_below_l: turnover-decayed float-turnover proxy in -1<=z<0 through attack start
variables.gap_age_sessions: attack-start calendar index minus primary-gap calendar index
variables.gap_density_relative_to_local: mean decayed gap-bin density / mean decayed local-bin density
variables.gap_lvn_score: one minus gap density relative to local-bin mean, clipped only as a descriptive score to [-5,1]
variables.higher_low_share_10d: share of prior-10 completed sessions with higher coordinate low
variables.nearest_hvn_above_l_distance_z: nearest >=70th-percentile positive-density bin center above L
variables.nearest_hvn_above_u_distance_z: nearest >=70th-percentile positive-density bin center above U
variables.new_lower_cluster_since_gap: count of causally frozen lower clusters known before attack start
variables.number_of_prior_contacts_with_l: prior causal upward L contacts before current attack
variables.overhang_support_ratio: (decayed inside + decayed above) / max(decayed support, epsilon)
variables.overhead_density_relative_to_support: mean decayed inside+above density / mean support density
variables.poc_migration_into_gap: indicator POC moved from below L into [0,1)
variables.poc_migration_toward_l: attack-start POC distance improvement toward z=0 versus gap-time POC
variables.poc_z: z-center of highest turnover-decayed histogram bin
variables.price_progress_per_turnover_since_gap: coordinate progress from post-gap low to attack start divided by turnover
variables.raw_vap_above_u_20: local-normalized raw minute volume in 1<=z<2 over exact prior 20 sessions
variables.raw_vap_below_l_support_20: local-normalized raw minute volume in -1<=z<0 over exact prior 20 sessions
variables.raw_vap_inside_gap_20: local-normalized raw minute volume inside 0<=z<1 over exact prior 20 sessions
variables.stock_minus_board_return_10d: stock prior-10 completed-session return minus board return
variables.stock_minus_industry_return_10d: stock prior-10 completed-session return minus PIT-industry return
variables.structural_stop_distance: entry coordinate price distance to L-W
variables.target_to_risk_ratio: remaining net target / structural stop distance
variables.vacuum_score: equal-weight causal expanding percentiles specified in vap_methodology
